description: Implementation of TimedText3GPPSource class for handling 3GPP timed text data in Android media framework, including reading text buffers, extracting descriptions, and managing format metadata.

classes.name: TimedText3GPPSource
classes.description: Class for processing 3GPP timed text data, providing methods to read text samples, extract descriptions, and access format metadata.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a text sample, extracts timing and descriptions, and marks end time as unavailable.

methods.name: extractAndAppendLocalDescriptions
methods.description: Extracts local descriptions from a text buffer and appends them to a parcel.

methods.name: extractGlobalDescriptions
methods.description: Extracts global text descriptions for the entire text track.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format metadata of the media source.
